title: Correction
description: One dated correction to a promoted record (ADR-007 section 10, REQ-002 R15). The record itself is edited in place; this entry, appended to `corrections.jsonl` in the data root and never rewritten, is what keeps the previous value readable. The raw capture the record came from is untouched.

record_type.description: The entity schema the corrected record validates against.

previous.description: The field's value before the correction, of any JSON type. Null when the field was null, or when it was absent, in which case `previous_absent` is true.

previous_absent.description: True when the field did not exist on the record before the correction, so a null `previous` means absent rather than null. Omitted otherwise.

new.description: The field's value after the correction, of any JSON type.

corrected.description: The date the correction was made.

reason.description: Why the owner corrected it, when stated.
